title: Basics of Stepper Motors
creator: Oriental Motor
prerequisites: Basic current, magnet, and rotation concepts
why: Connects driver phase sequencing with the rotor and distinguishes permanent-magnet, variable-reluctance, and hybrid stepper construction.
first_task: Identify the stationary and rotating parts, then explain what an open-loop step command does not measure when the load prevents motion.
limitations: Manufacturer examples and quoted accuracy specifications apply to their stated motors and conditions. They are not universal stepper ratings or a guarantee against missed motion.
evidence_note: Opened the official page and inspected its system, phase-drive, and motor-construction sections. Used for an original functional schematic; no vendor image copied.
